scope: Immutable source review and protocol references; not live AD DNS, KDC or ILM resolver acceptance.

sources.observation: validateDnsChallenge iterates attributes but calls record.get() once per attribute. It does not iterate all values in the TXT attribute. Current SingleTXT mode rejects coexistence rather than deleting foreign values.
Explicit pure-Go Kerberos configuration/password initiator and MIC methods; configuration is raw contents. Login/service-ticket APIs do not accept context.
Pinned Kerberos config parser and cryptographic dependency of bodgit/gssapi. Only explicit AES enctypes and pinned KDCs are accepted by this adapter.
RFC2136 packet helpers and TSIG provider support; ExchangeContext verifies present TSIG but does not require one. This adapter explicitly requires signed authoritative and UPDATE replies.

protocols.purpose: Full-set prerequisites, exact-RDATA deletes, atomicity and minimal UPDATE response format
GSS TKEY mode 3, mutual establishment and final-response signature verification
AD-integrated secure dynamic update and record permissions
Single-value Attribute.get semantics and unordered value selection
